policy.test: two-sided exact Mann–Whitney permutation test; tied ranks handled exactly
policy.unit: median of seven settled rounds from each independent process
policy.adjustment: Holm, conservative family includes all original profiles and both runtimes, including unmeasured tests as p=1
policy.scope: build-time generated Loculus versus ordinary Loculus, Zod jitless and Valibot; construction includes one valid validation; repeated validation excludes schema creation; bundling and code generation excluded from runtime timings
policy.caution: results apply to this machine, versions, fixtures and harness; observational process repetitions do not remove systematic environment bias
policy.invalidComparability: Peer claims require matching acceptance/rejection for every timed invalid input. Error counts/formats may differ. Holm adjusted p-values retain the original conservative full family.
